attribute_fields.COMMENTS: California military retirement exemption (2025). New $20,000 exemption with AGI limits: $125k single, $250k joint. SBP payments receive same treatment. Honors MSRRA and SCRA. Source: MOAA State Report Card, CA FTB.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize CA military retirement exemption calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "CA Military Retirement Exemption Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ca_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.ca_military_retirement_taxable xdef

condition_details.condition_postfix: result.filing_status "single" strcasecmp 0 eq result.agi result.ca_military_agi_limit_single le and
result.filing_status "married_filing_jointly" strcasecmp 0 eq result.filing_status "head_of_household" strcasecmp 0 eq or result.agi result.ca_military_agi_limit_joint le and

action_details.action_comment: Apply CA $20,000 military retirement exemption (Single, AGI ≤ $125k)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay result.ca_military_retirement_exemption_amount min /result.ca_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.ca_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.ca_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"CA military retirement exemption (Single): $" result.ca_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", AGI: $" strconcat result.agi cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.ca_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Apply CA $20,000 military retirement exemption (Joint, AGI ≤ $250k)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay result.ca_military_retirement_exemption_amount min /result.ca_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.ca_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.ca_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"CA military retirement exemption (Joint/HOH): $" result.ca_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", AGI: $" strconcat result.agi cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.ca_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No CA military retirement exemption (AGI exceeds limit)
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /result.ca_military_retirement_exemption xdef result.military_retirement_pay /result.ca_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"CA military retirement: NO EXEMPTION (AGI exceeds limit). Retirement: $" result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", AGI: $" strconcat result.agi cvs strconcat ", Fully taxable" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.ca_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.ca_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No CA military retirement pay - exemption not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: California state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure with 10 brackets (1% to 13.3%) plus Mental Health Services Tax (1% surtax on income over $1M). Highest state tax rates in the nation. Per California Franchise Tax Board (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "California Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ca_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.ca_mental_health_tax xdef 0.0 /result.ca_total_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Head of Household
condition_details.condition_description: Filing Status is MFJ or HOH
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.filing_status "married_filing_jointly" strcasecmp 0 eq result.filing_status "head_of_household" strcasecmp 0 eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate CA tax for Single filers using progressive brackets (10 brackets: 1% to 13.3%)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.ca_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /ca_agi xdef
ca_agi result.ca_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max dup /ca_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /ca_tax xdef
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_1_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_1_rate mul /ca_tax xdef
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_1_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_2_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_1_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_2_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_2_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_3_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_2_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_3_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_3_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_4_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_3_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_4_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_4_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_5_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_4_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_5_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_5_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_6_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_5_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_6_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_6_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_7_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_6_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_7_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_7_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_8_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_7_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_8_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_8_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_9_limit_single min result.ca_bracket_8_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_9_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_9_limit_single gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_9_limit_single sub result.ca_bracket_10_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
0.0 /ca_mh_tax xdef ca_taxable_income result.ca_mental_health_tax_threshold gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_mental_health_tax_threshold sub result.ca_mental_health_tax_rate mul /ca_mh_tax xdef } if
ca_tax /result.ca_state_tax xdef ca_mh_tax /result.ca_mental_health_tax xdef ca_tax ca_mh_tax add /result.ca_total_tax xdef ca_tax ca_mh_tax add /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"California tax calculated (Single): Base tax: $" result.ca_state_tax cvs strconcat ", Mental Health Tax: $" strconcat result.ca_mental_health_tax cvs strconcat ", Total: $" strconcat result.ca_total_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate CA tax for Married Filing Jointly/HOH using progressive brackets (10 brackets: 1% to 13.3%)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.ca_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /ca_agi xdef
ca_agi result.ca_standard_deduction_joint sub 0 max dup /ca_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /ca_tax xdef
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_1_limit_joint min result.ca_bracket_1_rate mul /ca_tax xdef
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_1_limit_joint gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_2_limit_joint min result.ca_bracket_1_limit_joint sub result.ca_bracket_2_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_2_limit_joint gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_3_limit_joint min result.ca_bracket_2_limit_joint sub result.ca_bracket_3_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_3_limit_joint gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_4_limit_joint min result.ca_bracket_3_limit_joint sub result.ca_bracket_4_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_4_limit_joint gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_5_limit_joint min result.ca_bracket_4_limit_joint sub result.ca_bracket_5_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_5_limit_joint gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_6_limit_joint min result.ca_bracket_5_limit_joint sub result.ca_bracket_6_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_6_limit_joint gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_7_limit_joint min result.ca_bracket_6_limit_joint sub result.ca_bracket_7_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_7_limit_joint gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_8_limit_joint min result.ca_bracket_7_limit_joint sub result.ca_bracket_8_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_8_limit_joint gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_9_limit_joint min result.ca_bracket_8_limit_joint sub result.ca_bracket_9_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_9_limit_joint gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_bracket_9_limit_joint sub result.ca_bracket_10_rate mul ca_tax add /ca_tax xdef } if
0.0 /ca_mh_tax xdef ca_taxable_income result.ca_mental_health_tax_threshold gt { ca_taxable_income result.ca_mental_health_tax_threshold sub result.ca_mental_health_tax_rate mul /ca_mh_tax xdef } if
ca_tax /result.ca_state_tax xdef ca_mh_tax /result.ca_mental_health_tax xdef ca_tax ca_mh_tax add /result.ca_total_tax xdef ca_tax ca_mh_tax add /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"California tax calculated (MFJ/HOH): Base tax: $" result.ca_state_tax cvs strconcat ", Mental Health Tax: $" strconcat result.ca_mental_health_tax cvs strconcat ", Total: $" strconcat result.ca_total_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
